neighbours.label: ' with' in archaic or biblical verse (crowned me with mercy, filled with joy, and our tongue with singing); plain modern ' with' stays quiet
fire: Let the heavens be glad, and the earth rejoice with singing.
Thou hast anointed my head with oil, and crowned me with mercy.
Bless the Lord with all thy soul.
He hath filled the hungry with good things.
My cup runneth over with gladness, and my heart with praise.
Wash me with thy tears and clothe me with thy love.
Come, sweet love, and with thy kisses stop my mouth.
Speak thou with me, O Lord, and I shall hear.
